column1: # BAL-F22R (15 Oct 2026, account 1): further glossed runs of the same Bouthillier office hand (Baluze 169 c164, c166, c170, c171 = the f.80
# Memoire and its continuation, July 1639), read by this worker's eye at 2400 px with 2x zooms of each target numeral. Not blind: I knew
# key.tsv. Same conventions as glossed_pairs.tsv (' = separate rising acute stroke; : = a second dot over the right-hand digit, the 1's own
# i-dot not counted; plain = no mark). Only target-bearing runs, with the neighbours I could place. 65? = mark not settled (not scored).
